lines.en: Let's clean this medicine box. Do you have time?
lines.ko: 이 약 상자 정리해요. 시간 괜찮아요?

lines.en: Sure, Mother. Does this syrup expire soon?
lines.ko: 네, 어머니. 이 시럽은 기한이 곧 지나요?

lines.en: Let me see. It expired last month.
Then I will throw it away.
Thank you. Keep the vitamin and the tablets here.
How many tablets is your daily dose?
One after breakfast and one after dinner.
lines.ko: 아침 먹고 하나, 저녁 먹고 하나예요.

lines.en: What about this small ointment?
It's for my hand. The effect is good.
Good. I will buy a new bandage tomorrow.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 내일 새 붕대를 사 올게요.

dialogs.about: 약국에서 약사에게 처방전을 내고 복용법을 물어요

lines.en: Hello. Here is my prescription, please.
Thank you. You have tablets and one syrup.
What is the daily dose?
Two tablets a day, after meals.
lines.ko: 하루에 알약 두 개, 식사 후에 드세요.

lines.en: Is the capsule the same?
No. One capsule at night is enough.
I took a vitamin this morning. Is that okay?
Yes. The vitamin is fine with this medicine.
lines.ko: 네. 비타민은 이 약과 같이 드셔도 괜찮아요.

lines.en: Thank you. Will this medicine expire soon?
lines.ko: 고마워요. 이 약은 기한이 곧 지날까요?

lines.en: No, not for one year. I will write the date.
lines.ko: 아니요, 일 년은 괜찮아요. 날짜를 적어 드릴게요.
